GET /v1/premium/tiers.purpose: Return the active server-maintained Premium tier and capability catalogue, mission-supplied display-price labels, and the currently configured Apple sandbox purchase products.
GET /v1/premium/tiers.authorization: Any authenticated account may read the catalogue. Product mappings are server-selected; clients cannot submit tier, price or entitlement facts.

request.validation: No route parameters, query parameters or request body.

401: UNAUTHENTICATED when a required GreenField bearer session is missing, invalid or expired.
500: SERVER_ERROR for an unclassified internal failure; signed billing payloads and private account facts are never returned.
503: CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE when the active Premium catalogue is unavailable.

GET /v1/premium/tiers.pagination: Not paginated and accepts no filtering parameters.
GET /v1/premium/tiers.idempotencyConcurrency: Read-only. Repeated and concurrent reads do not mutate entitlement state; Cache-Control no-store prevents stale commercial state.
GET /v1/premium/tiers.versioningCompatibility: HTTP v1 and response schemaVersion 1 where present. The server remains authoritative; sandbox transactions cannot establish production entitlement or identity verification. Display prices are labels only and do not declare a billing period or purchasable App Store product.

GET /v1/me/membership.purpose: Return the authenticated account's effective server-authoritative membership, billing status, badge preference and purchase availability.
GET /v1/me/membership.authorization: Strictly self-scoped. The account and actor identifiers are resolved from the authenticated session; no client-supplied owner identifier is accepted.

request.validation: No route parameters, query parameters or request body.

401: UNAUTHENTICATED when a required GreenField bearer session is missing, invalid or expired.
500: SERVER_ERROR for an unclassified internal failure; signed billing payloads and private account facts are never returned.

GET /v1/me/membership.pagination: Not paginated and accepts no filtering parameters.
GET /v1/me/membership.idempotencyConcurrency: Read-only account projection. Expired active/grace records are projected as Core without deleting historical membership or user data.
GET /v1/me/membership.versioningCompatibility: HTTP v1 and response schemaVersion 1 where present. The server remains authoritative; sandbox transactions cannot establish production entitlement or identity verification.

GET /v1/me/entitlements.purpose: Evaluate every Premium capability for the authenticated account from the active catalogue and effective membership state.
GET /v1/me/entitlements.authorization: Strictly self-scoped; the server derives account and actor identity from the bearer session.

request.validation: No route parameters, query parameters or request body.

401: UNAUTHENTICATED when a required GreenField bearer session is missing, invalid or expired.
500: SERVER_ERROR for an unclassified internal failure; signed billing payloads and private account facts are never returned.
503: CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE when the active Premium catalogue is unavailable.

GET /v1/me/entitlements.pagination: Not paginated and accepts no filtering parameters.
GET /v1/me/entitlements.idempotencyConcurrency: Read-only deterministic evaluation for a catalogue and membership revision. A client flag such as premium=true is never consulted.
GET /v1/me/entitlements.versioningCompatibility: HTTP v1 and response schemaVersion 1 where present. The server remains authoritative; sandbox transactions cannot establish production entitlement or identity verification.

GET /v1/me/entitlements/:capabilityId.purpose: Evaluate one named Premium capability for the authenticated account.
GET /v1/me/entitlements/:capabilityId.authorization: Strictly self-scoped; the server derives account and actor identity from the bearer session.

request.validation: Fastify rejects malformed capability identifiers; the service resolves the identifier only from the active server catalogue.

401: UNAUTHENTICATED when a required GreenField bearer session is missing, invalid or expired.
404: NOT_FOUND when capabilityId is absent from the active catalogue.
500: SERVER_ERROR for an unclassified internal failure; signed billing payloads and private account facts are never returned.
503: CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE when the active Premium catalogue is unavailable.

GET /v1/me/entitlements/:capabilityId.pagination: Not paginated and accepts no filtering parameters.
GET /v1/me/entitlements/:capabilityId.idempotencyConcurrency: Read-only deterministic evaluation for a catalogue and membership revision.
GET /v1/me/entitlements/:capabilityId.versioningCompatibility: HTTP v1 and response schemaVersion 1 where present. The server remains authoritative; sandbox transactions cannot establish production entitlement or identity verification.

PATCH /v1/me/membership/badge-visibility.purpose: Set whether the authenticated account's eligible Premium membership badge is publicly visible, independently of membership entitlement and identity verification.
PATCH /v1/me/membership/badge-visibility.authorization: Strictly self-scoped; the account and actor are resolved from the bearer session. The request cannot alter tier, payment state or identity verification.

body.visible: Required boolean; the only accepted field.

request.validation: A JSON object is required. Unknown fields, missing visible and non-boolean values are rejected.

success.data: Updated membership projection with badgeVisible and incremented preference audit state.

400: VALIDATION_FAILED for missing, non-boolean or unknown body fields.
401: UNAUTHENTICATED when a required GreenField bearer session is missing, invalid or expired.
500: SERVER_ERROR for an unclassified internal failure; signed billing payloads and private account facts are never returned.

PATCH /v1/me/membership/badge-visibility.pagination: Not paginated and accepts no filtering parameters.
PATCH /v1/me/membership/badge-visibility.idempotencyConcurrency: A transaction upserts the account preference and appends an audit event. Last committed write is authoritative; repeating the same value is safe but creates another auditable preference event.
PATCH /v1/me/membership/badge-visibility.versioningCompatibility: HTTP v1 and response schemaVersion 1 where present. The server remains authoritative; sandbox transactions cannot establish production entitlement or identity verification.

POST /v1/me/membership/apple-purchase-co.purpose: Create or return the authenticated account's stable Apple appAccountToken and the operator-confirmed sandbox products to pass into StoreKit purchase operations.
POST /v1/me/membership/apple-purchase-co.authorization: Strictly self-scoped. The server generates and binds the UUID to the authenticated account; client-supplied account IDs, tokens, products and tiers are rejected.

request.validation: Unknown fields and non-object bodies are rejected.

401: UNAUTHENTICATED when a required GreenField bearer session is missing, invalid or expired.
500: SERVER_ERROR for an unclassified internal failure; signed billing payloads and private account facts are never returned.
503: CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE when the Apple verifier is disabled, the catalogue is unavailable or no sandbox products are configured.

POST /v1/me/membership/apple-purchase-co.pagination: Not paginated and accepts no filtering parameters.
POST /v1/me/membership/apple-purchase-co.idempotencyConcurrency: Idempotent per account. Database uniqueness on account_id and app_account_token makes concurrent initialization return one stable binding.
POST /v1/me/membership/apple-purchase-co.versioningCompatibility: HTTP v1 and response schemaVersion 1 where present. The server remains authoritative; sandbox transactions cannot establish production entitlement or identity verification. Products must be explicitly confirmed and configured by a QA operator; no product identifiers are seeded.

POST /v1/premium/apple/transactions.purpose: Verify an Apple StoreKit 2 sandbox signed transaction and transactionally project the authenticated account's Premium membership.
POST /v1/premium/apple/transactions.authentication: Required GreenField bearer access session plus a cryptographically valid Apple signed transaction.
POST /v1/premium/apple/transactions.authorization: The verified appAccountToken and original transaction chain must belong to the authenticated account. Only PURCHASED auto-renewable sandbox subscriptions mapped to active server products are accepted; family-shared, production, forged and cross-account transactions fail closed.

body.signedTransaction: Required compact JWS string, 16 to 200000 characters; the only accepted field.

request.validation: Apple certificate chain, signature, bundle ID, Sandbox environment, transaction type, ownership, product mapping, dates and account binding are validated server-side. Raw signed data is redacted from logs and not persisted.

400: VALIDATION_FAILED for malformed/unknown input, signature or certificate failure, invalid verified fields, inconsistent dates or a future signedDate.
401: UNAUTHENTICATED when a required GreenField bearer session is missing, invalid or expired.
403: FORBIDDEN for production/family-shared/unsupported transactions, absent or mismatched account binding, or an original transaction owned by another account.
409: CONFLICT for a transaction concurrency invariant violation.
500: SERVER_ERROR for an unclassified internal failure; signed billing payloads and private account facts are never returned.
503: CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE when verification is disabled, the product is not enabled or the Premium catalogue is unavailable.

POST /v1/premium/apple/transactions.pagination: Not paginated and accepts no filtering parameters.
POST /v1/premium/apple/transactions.idempotencyConcurrency: The signed evidence SHA-256 and unique (transaction_id,evidence_sha256) event constraint make exact retries idempotent. A per-account PostgreSQL advisory transaction lock serializes projection updates; revision changes only when effective membership changes.
POST /v1/premium/apple/transactions.versioningCompatibility: HTTP v1 and response schemaVersion 1 where present. The server remains authoritative; sandbox transactions cannot establish production entitlement or identity verification. Uses Apple App Store Server Library signed-data verification in Sandbox only. Production transactions are rejected.

POST /v1/premium/apple/notifications.purpose: Receive, verify and replay-protect Apple App Store Server Notifications V2 for sandbox Premium subscriptions.
POST /v1/premium/apple/notifications.authentication: No user bearer session. Authorization is the verified Apple JWS certificate chain, signature, bundle identity and Sandbox environment.
POST /v1/premium/apple/notifications.authorization: Only cryptographically verified Apple notifications are processed. Embedded transaction and renewal JWS values are independently verified. Account binding is resolved only from verified appAccountToken or an existing original-transaction ownership record.

body.signedPayload: Required App Store Server Notifications V2 compact JWS, 16 to 200000 characters; the only accepted field.

request.validation: Outer notification and nested transaction/renewal signatures, bundle ID, environment, identifiers, dates and stored product mappings are validated. Raw JWS data is redacted and never stored.

success.data: Either {accepted:true,replay,notificationUuid,notificationType,state:'processed|ignored|unbound',reasonCode,transactionId} or the verified transaction projection response.

400: VALIDATION_FAILED for malformed/unknown input, signature/certificate failure or invalid verified fields.
401: UNAUTHENTICATED when a required GreenField bearer session is missing, invalid or expired.
403: FORBIDDEN for non-Sandbox or unsupported verified transaction ownership/type.
409: CONFLICT when a notification UUID is replayed with different signed evidence.
500: SERVER_ERROR for an unclassified internal failure; signed billing payloads and private account facts are never returned.
503: CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE when sandbox verification or required catalogue/product state is unavailable.

POST /v1/premium/apple/notifications.pagination: Not paginated and accepts no filtering parameters.
POST /v1/premium/apple/notifications.idempotencyConcurrency: notificationUUID is the replay key. Same UUID plus same evidence returns replay=true; same UUID with different evidence is rejected. Transaction evidence uniqueness and per-account advisory locks prevent duplicate entitlement side effects.
POST /v1/premium/apple/notifications.versioningCompatibility: HTTP v1 and response schemaVersion 1 where present. The server remains authoritative; sandbox transactions cannot establish production entitlement or identity verification. App Store Server Notifications V2 Sandbox only; no production notification URL is activated by this PR.

PUT /v1/admin/qa/premium/:handle.purpose: Assign an auditable synthetic Premium membership fixture to a test account in isolated QA.
PUT /v1/admin/qa/premium/:handle.authorization: Requires admin:ops. The route is registered only when the non-production QA assignment flag is enabled and is refused by configuration in production.

body.tier: Required: core, plus, horizon, horizon_plus or studio.
body.subscriptionStatus: Optional: active, expired, revoked or downgraded; defaults active.
body.expiresAt: Optional ISO date-time later than effectiveAt.

request.validation: Unknown and privileged fields are rejected; the target account is resolved server-side.

success.data: Updated target membership projection; entitlementSource is qa_fixture.

400: VALIDATION_FAILED for malformed fields, invalid timestamps, invalid tier/status, expiry ordering or missing Idempotency-Key.
401: UNAUTHENTICATED when a required GreenField bearer session is missing, invalid or expired.
404: NOT_FOUND when the handle or account actor does not exist.
500: SERVER_ERROR for an unclassified internal failure; signed billing payloads and private account facts are never returned.

PUT /v1/admin/qa/premium/:handle.pagination: Not paginated and accepts no filtering parameters.
PUT /v1/admin/qa/premium/:handle.idempotencyConcurrency: Idempotency-Key is unique in the membership event ledger. Exact retries return the current membership without a duplicate fixture event; membership revision advances on a new assignment.
PUT /v1/admin/qa/premium/:handle.versioningCompatibility: HTTP v1, QA-only synthetic operation. It cannot process payment, grant identity verification or be enabled in production.

PUT /v1/admin/qa/premium/apple-products/.purpose: Configure or disable one operator-confirmed Apple sandbox product-to-tier mapping for QA purchase verification.
PUT /v1/admin/qa/premium/apple-products/.authorization: Requires admin:ops. The route is available only with QA assignments and Apple sandbox verification enabled; both are refused in production.

path.productId: Required App Store product identifier matching ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{2,159}$.

body.tier: Required paid tier: plus, horizon, horizon_plus or studio.
body.state: Optional: active or disabled; defaults active.

request.validation: Unknown fields, Core mappings, invented billing periods and malformed identifiers are rejected. The server selects the active Premium catalogue.

400: VALIDATION_FAILED for malformed path/body values or unknown fields.
401: UNAUTHENTICATED when a required GreenField bearer session is missing, invalid or expired.
409: CONFLICT when another active product already maps to the same catalogue tier and billing period.
500: SERVER_ERROR for an unclassified internal failure; signed billing payloads and private account facts are never returned.
503: CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE when sandbox verification or the active catalogue is unavailable.

PUT /v1/admin/qa/premium/apple-products/.pagination: Not paginated and accepts no filtering parameters.
PUT /v1/admin/qa/premium/apple-products/.idempotencyConcurrency: Upsert by productId. A PostgreSQL advisory lock and partial unique index allow only one active product per catalogue tier, billing period and Sandbox environment.
PUT /v1/admin/qa/premium/apple-products/.versioningCompatibility: HTTP v1, QA Sandbox only. Product identifiers are never seeded or inferred; App Store Connect confirmation is an external prerequisite.
